test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

FELT : PAVP :: SACK : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a1cb7c3e5db90bdbf809148ded2acbe60f99f0f2efb8268be121487c3704fed.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**The first and third letter is added with +10.**

**The second and fourth letter is subtracted with -4.**

FELT : PAVP

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4ee420f223c2a9bd947a42aa53d4b49308726a2a215df22c23d3aebf0b0a3a5.png] 

Similarly,

SACK : ? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a15f97901bc2e32aabcf22494e352d7ec30bf0882ba26d6ab2c326a6f7d6435.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"CWMG".**
